test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Sravan hires a pre-paid taxi at Terminal A and drives 18 km towards the north. He takes a right turn and drives 40 km to reach Junction X. He then drives 15 km after taking a left turn to reach Junction Y. Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 40 km and stops at Terminal B.

How far is Terminal A with respect to Terminal B?
solution:
i) Sravan hires a pre-paid taxi at Terminal A and drives 18 km towards the north.

ii) He takes a right turn and drives 40 km to reach Junction X.

iii) He then drives 15 km after taking a left turn to reach Junction Y.

iv) Finally, he takes a left turn and drives 40 km, and stops at Terminal B.

For this question, the directions are given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/640d1eeb086e9ed6d6855018df377ee02b97a6a7c086451f82bc4219bf255d30.png] 

Here, the distance between terminal A and B is 15 + 18 = 33 Km.

Hence, **Option (2)** is correct.
